# اِعْتَمَرْتَ (iʕtamarta) /iʕ.ta.mar.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of اِعْتَمَرَ (iʕtamara)
# اِعْتَمَرْتِ (iʕtamarti) /iʕ.ta.mar.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of اِعْتَمَرَ (iʕtamara)
# اِعْتَمَرَتْ (iʕtamarat) /iʕ.ta.ma.rat/: third-perso
